youartdesktopapp.description: Generate AI images and videos free on YouArt — Free Mode runs select models at zero credits. Unlimited models, templates and workflows, plus a path to monetize.

l.description: Press ⌘L on your own site. Type over the words, circle what’s wrong or talk it through. Then, Letter opens the pull request.

yogurt.description: Yogurt takes meeting notes with AI that runs locally on Mac, Windows and Linux. No bot joins the call. Free and open source.

neurahq.description: An AI agent for consumer brands that recommends, sells and supports, remembers every shopper, and sounds like your brand on every channel.

threedev.description: Before your users tell you. three.dev scores your live traffic and lists what fails.

harnessmemory.description: Agents that remember: long-term memory built into HarnessRouter, recalled in any later session and shared by agents on different harnesses.

pluraisimulation.description: Agentic world simulation and model post-training that continuously optimize intelligence and cost.

cloudwaysvelocity.description: With Cloudways Managed Node.js hosting, deploy production-ready Node.js apps in minutes on managed infrastructure. Enterprise CDN, DDoS protection, malware protection, and flat pricing from $20.

crossfade.description: Crossfade is a plugin for Figma design that connects your coding agent, such as Claude Code, to the file you have open. Real layers, on your own machine, with no MCP limits.

klang.description: Klang captures, transcribes, and analyzes conversations that matter. European AI for teams that need searchable insights, traceability, and data control.

leasewire.description: Your own Excel model, filled in. Every value cited to its page and checked before delivery.

jot20.description: Jot is a local-first notes inbox for your Mac. Capture anything in a keystroke and it lands as a plain markdown file in a folder you own. One-time, from $9 launch for 1 Mac ($29), $24 for 3 ($87), $69 for 10 ($290). 7-day refund.
